versions.changelog:
Initial release of daily-weather-news, providing automated daily weather and news updates with Feishu push.

- Fetches accurate weather info via Open-Meteo API using city coordinates, with Chinese weather descriptions.
- Searches and summarizes Chinese international news using Tavily API, prioritizing major trusted news sites.
- Generates intelligent clothing advice based on weather data.
- Supports Feishu message push with formatted content and emoji.
- Enables both scheduled automatic push and on-demand manual query.
- Provides robust configuration and error handling with logging support.
